title: Law to require disclosure of paid government social media posts
summary: This bill would require public servants to disclose when governmental funds or resources are used to pay for third-party public communications, such as social media or influencer content, by adding the phrase "Paid Partnership with the City of New York" or the relevant agency's name. The requirement would apply to text, audio and video communications, including translated versions for non-English content. Intentional violations would be a misdemeanor, and the Campaign Finance Board and Conflicts of Interest Board could impose civil penalties of up to $10,000 per violation, with the law taking effect 90 days after becoming law.
